title: REQ · Scene objects support keyboard focus and activation
summary: Keyboard focus cycling and Enter/Space activation through buildScene
description: Context: no keyboard access exists. Desired behavior: SceneObject has focus() and blur() applying the same highlight and label as hover, and handleKey(key) that activates when focused and isActivationKey. buildScene-level SceneFocus helper cycles focus across visible objects using nextFocusIndex. Expected result: users can Tab/arrow to an object and press Enter or Space to open its actions. Why: interactive objects must be keyboard accessible.
acceptance_criteria: Given a focused visible object, When Enter or Space is pressed, Then the interact event is emitted
Given an unfocused object, When Enter is pressed, Then nothing is emitted
Given three objects with the second hidden, When focus moves next twice from the first, Then focus lands on the third then wraps to the first
Given focus moves away, When blur runs, Then highlight and label turn off
